Kharad

Overview

Kharad once hunted people like the fugitives of the Last Shelter. Disillusioned by his Khadaganian superiors, he now seeks revenge and offers his fighting skills to Zak. Loyalty to the brotherhood and his unfinished quarrel with the authorities keep him in Suslanger. [1, 2, 3]

Recruitment and farewell

Kharad once hunted people like Zak in imperial service. Disillusionment with his superiors turned him against them and brought him to the brotherhood. He offers to make his revenge useful to Zak’s search, while Zak asks him to temper enthusiasm with caution. Khatul’s need for a guard at the Shelter can prevent his recruitment. If he reaches Gipath with Zak, his farewell rejects a new life there: loyalty to the brothers and unfinished revenge call him back to Suslanger. [1, 2, 3, 4]
